title: Does Learning Order Explain Forgetting? The Lie Bracket as an Early-Warning Signal for Catastrophic Forgetting Without Old Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.20087v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A network trained on task A and then task B ends at different weights than one trained on B and then A. To leading order this gap is set by the Lie bracket of the two tasks' gradient fields, and Dherin (2023) conjectured that a non-vanishing bracket may be linked to catastrophic forgetting. I test this conjecture empirically. Across Split MNIST, Split Fashion-MNIST and Split CIFAR-10, the forgetting of A is almost exactly the difference in A's loss between the two training orders (Spearman rho = 0.96-1.00). I then ask whether the bracket can predict that forgetting early in training on B and without any of A's data, using only a small summary stored when A finishes: its gradient and its top 20 Hessian eigenpairs. When the old task is well learned and forgetting is slow (task-incremental), this stored bracket ranks forgetting with rho = 0.70-0.81, against 0.33-0.58 for the penalty of Elastic Weight Consolidation, and matches or exceeds re

translated_title: 学习顺序能否解释遗忘？李括号作为无需旧数据的灾难性遗忘早期预警信号
translated_abstract: 先在任务A上训练、再在任务B上训练的网络，其最终权重与先训练B再训练A的网络不同。在主导阶上，这一差距由两个任务梯度场的李括号（Lie bracket）决定，Dherin (2023) 猜想非零的李括号可能与灾难性遗忘相关。本文对这一猜想进行了实证检验。在Split MNIST、Split Fashion-MNIST 和 Split CIFAR-10 上，任务A的遗忘几乎恰好等于两种训练顺序下A的损失之差（Spearman rho = 0.96-1.00）。随后，作者进一步探究李括号能否在任务B训练早期、且不使用A的任何数据的情况下预测遗忘——仅利用A训练结束时存储的小型摘要信息：其梯度及其前20个Hessian特征对。当旧任务已被充分学习且遗忘较慢（任务增量式学习）时，这个存储的李括号对遗忘的排序相关系数达到 rho = 0.70-0.81，而 Elastic Weight Consolidation（EWC）惩罚项仅为 0.33-0.58，并且匹配或超过（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文实证验证了两个任务梯度场的李括号决定了训练顺序导致的权重差异并与灾难性遗忘相关，且仅凭旧任务训练结束时存储的梯度和前20个Hessian特征对，就能在无需旧数据的条件下早期预测遗忘，效果优于EWC惩罚项。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically confirms that the Lie bracket of two tasks' gradient fields explains order-dependent weight differences and relates to catastrophic forgetting, and shows that a small stored summary of the old task (gradient plus top-20 Hessian eigenpairs) can predict forgetting early in training without old data, ranking forgetting better than EWC's penalty.
